purpose: Confirm or reject the visual observations bound to one immutable P0 visual-output hash.
required_checks: Compare the supplied LF login screenshot with the review packet's responsive variants, visible fields, actions and legal/contact elements.
Use CONFIRM_OBSERVATION only when no material visual mismatch is known; otherwise request a new capture/context, reject, or escalate.
Do not interpret the review as runtime, security, privacy, benchmark, production or merge acceptance.
Do not mutate the locked visual output; corrections require a separate adjudication overlay followed by J00R.
Confirm only the exact review_id, visual_output_sha256, challenge_sha256 and nonce carried by the issued challenge.
data_handling: The raw screenshot remains ephemeral; the repository retains hashes, sanitized review evidence and the external attestation reference only.
